reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Cleansing Oil 210mL
reviews.text:
I really loved this cleansing oil. It removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities so well without feeling heavy or greasy on the skin. What I liked most is that it melts everything down easily and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and comfortable, not stripped or dry.

It also emulsifies nicely with water, which makes it very easy to rinse off. My skin feels fresh after using it, and it fits perfectly as the first step in a double cleansing routine.

Overall, it’s a really great cleansing oil and I would definitely recommend it, especially if you want something effective but still gentle on the skin.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢支卸妝油。卸妝、防曬同日常污垢都卸得好徹底，又唔會覺得厚重或者油笠笠。我最鍾意嘅係佢可以好輕鬆咁溶解晒所有嘢，用完之後皮膚感覺清爽、柔軟、舒服，唔會繃緊或者乾燥。

同水乳化得好靚，所以好容易沖走。用完之後皮膚感覺清新，喺雙重清潔程序中做第一步就啱晒。

整體嚟講真係一支好正嘅卸妝油，絕對推薦，尤其係想要效果好但對皮膚溫和嘅人

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Cleansing Oil 210mL
reviews.text: i love this cleanser, its a viscous texture and takes off all my makeup & sunscreen. been repurchasing for a couple years now, even after trying other cleansers i always come back. can leave your eyes a bit blurry but i find it easy to wash out and doesnt irritate my sensitive eyes.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支卸妝油，質地黏稠，可以卸晒所有妝同防曬。回購咗幾年，即使試過其他卸妝產品我都係會返轉頭。可能會令眼睛有少少矇，但我就覺得好容易沖走，而且唔會刺激我嘅敏感肌眼

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Cleansing Oil 210mL
reviews.text: Really Good !!! My skin is oily and while it feels a little uncomfortable to put oil on my already oily face it actually does a good job at cleansing my skin ! It always leaves my skin smooth and soft afterwards while reducing black heads ! The smell also takes a bit getting used to but it's not really noticeable after using it a couple times. This was my 1st oil cleanser but i rlly recommend it ! I'll definitely keep buying.
reviews.zh: 非常好！！！我係油性肌，喺本身已經好油嘅面上面搽油會覺得有啲唔舒服，但係佢真係做到好好嘅清潔效果！用完之後皮膚一直都係又滑又軟，而且仲可以減黑頭！氣味都要啲時間習慣，但用多幾次之後就唔太聞得出。係我嘅第一支卸妝油，真心推薦！我一定會繼續回購

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Cleansing Oil 210mL
reviews.text:
Es muy buen aceite desmaquillante, lo único que no me gusta es su aroma, huele como a hiervas, bueno ese es el aroma que a mí me da. Yo prefiero que no traigan aroma, se va hasta que lo enjuagas.
Tiene buena consistencia, no muy pesado ni muy ligero, emulsiona bien y quita el maquillaje muy bien. En general me gusta solo el aroma es lo que no me convence.
reviews.zh: 係一支好好嘅卸妝油，唯一唔鍾意嘅係佢嘅氣味，聞落似草藥味，總之就係畀到我呢個感覺。我個人偏好冇香味嘅產品，要沖水之後先散。質地好好，唔會太重亦唔會太輕，乳化效果唔錯，卸妝都好乾淨。整體我鍾意，只係氣味呢一點唔啱我

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Cleansing Oil 210mL
reviews.text: I'm a 21 year old Korean man, have lot of products used fron oliveyoung ever since I was younger. To be honest with this product, this made the most satisfied experience for me whenever I use it before doing a cleansing form. Some of you might not like the smell it has, however, it makes huge difference between using the product and not. My face skin layer became much softer and clear than before when I used to felt so many traces spots of blamishes.
reviews.zh: 我係一個21歲嘅韓國仔，從細到大都用過好多Olive Young嘅產品。講真，呢支產品係我喺做正式清潔前用嘅時候，畀到我最滿意體驗嘅一支。你哋當中可能有人唔鍾意佢嘅氣味，但用同唔用嘅分別真係好大。我塊面嘅皮膚比以前柔軟同透徹好多，以前我成面都係暗瘡印

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Cleansing Oil 210mL
reviews.text: I was able to test this cleansing oil at last. I used just two pumps, as instructed, and it was sufficient to do a thorough cleaning. I am not sure if the strange scent came from the ginseng or the oil itself, but it smelled a lot like herbs.
reviews.zh: 終於試到呢支卸妝油。我跟住指示用兩下，已經足夠徹底清潔。我唔肯定嗰陣奇怪嘅氣味係人參味定係油本身嘅味，但聞落就好似草藥味
